commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=OS Comparison Worker (inventory-worker)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker
sleep 1
systemctl status inventory-worker --no-pager
